name: FM 2 Cards
author: FM 2
description: FM 2 cards: the Ember, Tide, Grove and Crypt lines, hybrids and T5 mixes; new cards built to be fused from weak cards into strong ones. Placeholder artwork (gradient + tier dots) until the final art is made.

cards.name: Pebble Raptor
cards.description:
A small raptor that
nests in warm ash
and cracked stone.

cards.name: Spark Beetle
cards.description:
Its wings leave a
trail of sparks. It
is the seed of the
Ember line.

cards.name: Ash Sparrow
cards.description:
Born from the embers
of a dead volcano.

cards.name: Foam Sprite
cards.description:
A shy spirit made of
sea foam. It pops
when it laughs.

cards.name: Reef Crab
cards.description:
Its shell is built
from coral and
stubbornness.

cards.name: Brine Eel
cards.description:
It hunts in the dark
water under the reef.

cards.name: Maelstrom Serpent
cards.description:
Fusion: Abyssal
Nautilus + Giant Red
Seasnake

cards.name: Leaf Grub
cards.description:
It eats one leaf a
day and dreams of
wings.

cards.name: Thorn Sprout
cards.description:
A seedling armed
with tiny thorns.

cards.name: Mossback Beetle
cards.description:
Moss grows on its
back, so the forest
hides it well.

cards.name: Bone Pup
cards.description:
A puppy that never
left its master's
grave.

cards.name: Grave Wisp
cards.description:
A pale flame that
flickers over old
tombs.

cards.name: Rattle Squire
cards.description:
A skeleton still
carrying a rusty
shield.

cards.name: Reefstone Sentinel
cards.description:
Fusion: Coral
Guardian + Giant
Soldier of Stone

cards.name: Bone Dragon Overlord
cards.description:
Fusion: Crypt
Keeper + Curse of
Dragon

cards.name: Mangrove Leviathan
cards.description:
Fusion: Tidal
Leviathan + World
Tree Guardian
